item.title: NEW FACES: New coach, new Cavs, but No. 17 College Park still playoff bound
item.description: 17 — COLLEGE PARK CAVALIERSMr. College Park, coach Clifton McNeely, went out on top. The only head coach in College Park High School history, McNeely led the Cavs to the State Final Four before retiring — leaving a legacy few programs could match. But the cupboard is far from bare. Kenneth Stephens takes over the reins, charged with maintaining the standard set by a legend.
